puzzle: Find the unique integer selector from 1 through 99 that has remainder 2 when divided by 5, remainder 0 when divided by 7, and remainder 7 when divided by 11. Work out the constraints before answering.
hard: Find the unique selector x with 1 <= x <= 999 such that 3*x + 4 is congruent to 12 modulo 13, 5*x - 6 is congruent to 29 modulo 31, and 7*x + 8 is congruent to 20 modulo 37. Derive the selector by reconciling all three congruences before answering.
